name: Send the refund Approval request to Slack

parameters.content:
## Refund  request 

approval business use case integrating with Slack interactivity

There are bi-directional workflows.  This is the workflow to send request to Slack. The workflow `Receive approve/ reject/ flag submission interactivity from Slack via Webhook` listens, processes blocks messages received from Slack and sends the confirmation message to Slack.

For your reference
[The Slack bot approval interactivity screenshot ](https://github.com/threecuptea/customer-support-agents/blob/main/n8n-slack-interactivity/slack-screenshot-screenshot-refund-request-approval.png).

n8n provides a Slack 'Send a message and Wait...' . That is a sync call and wait for approval.  What we want is an async workflow and let `Receive approve/ reject/ flag submission interactivity from Slack via Webhook` serves as an event-driven listener. 
Instead, we can use 'Send a message' component and  use 'Blocks' as the message type.

Slack provide [Slack Block Kit Builder Templates](https://app.slack.com/block-kit-builder/T0BHFGFMTJL/templates) and you can download or copy and modify from there.  Notice.  Slack blocks is using `mrkdwn` instead of `markdown` type.  Check out its syntax.  

It's easy for me to test using manual trigger "When clicking 'Execute workflow'".  You can swap it with 'Append row in sheet' as needed

Slack will post back the decision value (''approved'/ 'rejected'/ 'flagged')  of the dynamic interactivity action as well as the decision reason input response back to n8n.   Slack  won't post back 'refund_request_id', 'original_order_id', 'refund_amount'. etc on the top . Those are considered as static display-only text.  I need Slack to post back the  refund_request_id  associated with the decision action so that I can attribute the decision action, decision reason and decided_by with  its corresponding refund_request_id. In addition, I also need 'refund_amount' , and  'customer_name'  along with the  refund_request_id to send the confirmation message.   

I ends up encode those 3 fields in the 'block_id' of 'actions' field and separate them with '|' when I sent initial blocks message.  The receiving end would parses the 'block_id' and split them accordingly to recover those 3 fields.
